title: The cuts reach the bus stop
subtitle: Austin ISD's high school transportation, two weeks into the school year
alt: Timeline of the Austin Independent School District's high school bus changes: the district adopted a $205 million reduction package for the 2026-27 school year; it opened the year with 98 bus hubs an average of 2.5 miles from students' homes, replacing neighborhood stops; Communities In Schools closed a campaign at more than $354,200 on Aug. 31 to cover what the budget could not; and by Sept. 2 the district had 108 hubs about 1.5 miles from homes, with transportation savings put at $2.3 million, while Austin Ed Fund delivered $350,000 to 48 teacher-led projects
source: Austin ISD figures, via KUT and Community Impact
